newsitem.title: UK: Prodi confident Italy will qualify for EMU.
newsitem.headline: Prodi confident Italy will qualify for EMU.

text.p: Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Wednesday he was confident that his country would qualify to join a single European currency in 1999 without any need to adjust the criteria currently laid down.
Interviewed on BBC radio, Prodi denied Italy had sought a softening of tough criteria for membership of monetary union laid down in the bloc's Maastricht Treaty.
"They are the criteria we have to tackle," he said.
Prodi expressed doubts about Britain being among the founding members of the single currency.
"Britain will stay out until the moment in which one morning your Prime Minister... whoever... will declare "OK, it is in our national interest to get in'," he said.
